failure_summary: Run 44861140260 completed its producer cycle and persisted snapshot 146b6a6f, but its own committed no-pytest validation shim returned SHIM_FAIL (48 passed, 1 failed, 0 skipped, 1 unsupported). The failure is a producer-side test-harness/pin problem, not a gate verdict, not a provider/work-quantum starvation, not a lane write-scope violation and not a product defect. The lane's substantive FAST-MVP counter-authority deliverable in the same snapshot is intact and, on fresh re-execution, reproduces byte-for-byte except for the wall-clock timestamp.

two_causes.mechanism: evaluation/no_pytest_runner.py::run_file inserts only the repo root into sys.path (line 113). The producer invoked the shim without PYTHONPATH=/tmp/lex_accepted/product, so `from product.query.bundle import ...` (test_retrieval_benchmark.py:36) could not resolve. With PYTHONPATH set, this file advances to a numpy import boundary (product/query/qmap.py:6 `import numpy as np`), numpy being NOT_IMPORTABLE in the producer image; it is therefore reported IMPORT_ERROR and counted neither as passed nor as a counted FAIL.
two_causes.shim_status_after_repair: IMPORT_ERROR (missing numpy) - disclosed, not counted as pass or fail

two_causes.mechanism: The test's freeze pinned the live accepted product mount identity (mount_head, mount:state/product.json) to the pre-advance head 5fb312e4. By run 44861140260 the accepted mount had advanced to 7be4480e (accepted cycle 40284658455), so the live pin re-hash failed for exactly those two identity pins while all 50 population-bundle pins, all 15 probe-family pins and all evaluation-instrument pins still matched.
two_causes.producer_partial_repair: The producer already edited this test in the snapshot (MOUNT-DRIFT REPAIR docstring, lines 18-31; drift allowlist at 145-146; historical-tree re-verification at 149-164). But the two committed shim artifacts are byte-identical failed-attempt copies (sha 40637486...) recorded against the OLD test sha aeb835a2..., so the repaired test was never re-executed.
two_causes.resume_action: fetched the pinned historical product commit 5fb312e4 (pin-only network fetch, recorded separately), re-ran the shim on the repaired tree: this file now PASSES 14/14 with live-drift allowlist plus historical-tree verification.
